$comment: IA for the local Vault AI clone. Derived from CLONE_SPEC.md, CLONE_SPEC_pricing_migration.md, CLONE_SPEC_partners_ua_legal.md and src/pages + src/components as of 2026-10-14. Hand-edit this file only; IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs.

meta.source: https://www.usevault.ai/ (local clone of the site; this repository)

categories.CHROME: Site-wide frame: top navigation, footer, and the hairline grid frame with separators and cross markers.
categories.HERO: Page-opening block directly under the nav.
categories.NARRATIVE: Long-form positioning copy presented as a motion piece rather than a feature.
categories.FEATURES: Product or offer explanation modules: grids, tabbed showcases, lists, charts.
categories.PROCESS: Numbered, auto-advancing step sequences paired with a visual.
categories.COMMERCE: Plan comparison and pricing detail beyond the hero.
categories.CONTENT: Document-style body content with no marketing motion.

chrome.navbar.description: Top navigation: logo, section links (Product/Automation/Reports/Security), Pricing link, EN/UA switch, login and Get started CTA; below 1024px a burger opening an animated blurred dropdown. On non-home routes the logo links to / and section links to /#anchor; Pricing gets the active state on the pricing template.

chrome.grid-frame.description: Hairline layout frame: 1.5px white/5 side borders on each section, 1px separators between sections, 12px plus-shaped cross markers at separator corners.
chrome.grid-frame.scope: All 17 routes; wraps every section between nav and footer.

chrome.footer.description: Footer: brand mark and socials, Platform / Resources / Legal link columns, bottom bar with copyright and the Built by Overcode badge, plus the closing spacer.

hero.home-dashboard.description: Centred home hero: eyebrow pill, display h1, subtitle, Get started CTA, and the large dashboard screenshot with four glow layers over the planet background. Locale swaps the screenshot (hero-en / hero-uk).

hero.pricing-plans.description: Pricing hero: PRICING eyebrow, h1, Monthly/Annual segmented toggle (default Annual, sliding pill, '2 months free' badge) and the four plan cards (Free, Basic, Pro with gradient border and Recommended pill, Enterprise) whose prices fade on toggle.

hero.migration-split.description: Split hero for the migration offer: text column with h1 and Talk to us button on the left, an invoice mock on the right that reveals in sequence once and cross-fades the total.

hero.partners-split.description: Split hero for the partner programme: text column with h1 and Become a partner button on the left, an animated DOM scene (invite-link card, connector line, workspace list) on the right that plays once on entering view.

hero.not-found.description: Clone-only 404 block: eyebrow, h1, subtitle and a link home. Has no counterpart on the original site.

narrative.scroll-statement.description: Large paragraph whose words fill from ghost (0.2) to white one by one as the block scrolls from 90% to 25% of the viewport. Copy is per page; layout and motion are identical.
narrative.scroll-statement.scope: Home and partners templates (4 routes with locales).

features.product-grid.description: #product: 3x2 grid of product cards, each with a looping canvas Lottie that freezes off screen, a title and a short description.

features.showcase-automation.description: #automation tabbed showcase: three tabs that auto-advance with a linear progress bar (durations from Lottie markers, gated at 35% visibility), Lottie segment per tab, text and Try it free CTA.

features.showcase-reports.description: #reports tabbed showcase: same mechanics as the automation showcase with the reports Lottie and copy, mirrored layout.

features.showcase-security.description: #security tabbed showcase: same mechanics as the automation showcase with the security Lottie and copy.

features.migration-explainer.description: 'You don't pay for two tools at once': two explanatory paragraphs beside a 12-month timeline chart whose bars fill on scroll.

features.migration-conditions.description: 'The offer applies if': five eligibility conditions, each with an icon that animates once on scroll.

features.partner-audience.description: 'Who it's for': five-row audience list with icons that animate in on scroll.

features.partner-value-grid.description: 'What you and your clients get': two-column value grid (Your client / Your company) separated by an 'Or' divider.

commerce.compare-table.description: Compare plans: five-group feature table with a sticky header row and shaded Pro column from 768px; below 768px a sticky plan picker shows one plan column at a time.

support.faq-accordion.description: FAQ accordion under a section heading: multi-open items, 300ms grid-rows expand, chevron rotates 90deg to -90deg. Question set is per page.
support.faq-accordion.scope: Pricing, migration offer and partners templates.

process.lottie-steps.description: 'Gain Clarity on your Finances': three timed steps that expand in turn beside one Lottie, connector line grows 1.55s easeInOut, loops when the Lottie completes, Get started CTA. Carries the #how-it-works anchor on home only.

process.visual-steps.description: Four-step sequence that auto-advances every 5s while in view and loops; the connector between numbers fills over 4.8s; clicking a step selects it and restarts the timer; each step shows its own DOM mock screen (no Lottie). Step content is per page.

forms.partner-popup.description: 'Become a partner' modal: gradient-bordered form with validated fields, phone country dropdown with flags, Esc and focus trap, body scroll lock. In the clone the submit is simulated locally and never leaves the browser.
forms.partner-popup.scope: Partners template only; opened from its hero and CTA buttons.

content.legal-header.description: Opening of a legal document inside the bordered 750px frame: h1, the operator and effective-date line, and the optional intro (sub-processors) or preamble (DPA) before the first numbered part. Body text in the clone is placeholder.
content.legal-header.scope: Legal template: 8 routes (4 documents x 2 locales), once per page.

content.legal-section.description: One heading-bounded part of a legal document: top rule, numbered h2 with its paragraphs, lists, underlined links and tables that become stacked cards below 768px, plus any h3 sub-parts; in-page anchors smooth-scroll to 40px above the heading. Repeated once per h2. Body text in the clone is placeholder.
content.legal-section.scope: Legal template: 6 of 8 routes (terms, privacy, dpa x 2 locales; none on sub-processors), repeated per h2.
